article.story: Georgia Southern (6-4) at Troy (4-6), Nov. 21 at 4 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Georgia Southern by 8.5. Against the spread: Georgia Southern 9-1, Troy 3-7. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Georgia Southern Offense Overall: 411 yards per game (40th in FBS) Passing: 278.8 yards per game (16th) Rushing: 132.2 yards per game (101st) Scoring: 27.3 points per game (74th) Georgia Southern Defense Overall: 313.6 yards per game (26th in FBS) Passing: 185 yards per game (24th) Rushing: 128.6 yards per game (42nd) Scoring: 19.4 points per game (28th) Troy Offense Overall: 358.1 yards per game (87th in FBS) Passing: 186 yards per game (110th) Rushing: 172.1 yards per game (49th) Scoring: 21.5 points per game (110th) Troy Defense Overall: 347 yards per game (58th in FBS) Passing: 205.2 yards per game (58th) Rushing: 141.8 yards per game (68th) Scoring: 26.3 points per game (90th) Troy ranks 130th in third down percentage, converting 31.1% of the time. Georgia Southern ranks 15th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 31.5%. Both teams are heavily penalized. Georgia Southern ranks 127th in the FBS averaging 73.5 penalty yards per game, and Troy ranks 123rd with a 70.9-yard average. Both teams have strong red zone defenses. Georgia Southern is 21st in FBS, with opponents scoring on 75% of trips. Troy's red zone defense ranks 18th at 74.3%. Troy is 23rd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 31:54. Team leaders Georgia Southern Passing: Max Johnson, 2,398 yards, 17 TDs, 3 INTs, 68.7 completion percentage Rushing: David Mbadinga, 336 yards on 62 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Alex Taylor, 621 yards on 44 catches, 4 TDs Troy Passing: Will Crowder, 1,393 yards, 10 TDs, 5 INTs, 56.3 completion percentage Rushing: Gavin Griffin, 503 yards on 123 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Noreel White, 341 yards on 24 catches, 0 TDs Last game Georgia Southern defeated Georgia State 34-17 on Nov. 14. Johnson passed for 203 yards on 16-of-22 attempts (72.7%) with two touchdowns and one interception. Taeo Todd carried the ball 10 times for 77 yards. Taylor recorded 92 yards on six catches. Troy fell 27-14 to South Alabama on Nov. 14. Crowder led Troy with 231 yards on 24-of-41 passing (58.5%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 11 times for 58 yards and one rushing touchdown. Griffin had 38 rushing yards on 15 carries, adding one reception for four yards. White had four receptions for 55 yards. Next game Georgia Southern hosts Louisiana Tech on Nov. 28. Troy plays at Arkansas State on Nov. 28.
